name: Penetrator Round loads into an unloaded Gun weapon
notes: Penetrator Round's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost is 0 so materializing via a direct FSM click is free. Framework Sidearm (a REGALIA,WEAPON with the GUN subtype and no Subcards, i.e. unloaded) is seeded onto the field as the [REST] Load ability's target; loading removes the bullet from the field entirely (LoadBulletIntoGun() sets removed=true directly, no MZMove) and appends its CardID to the gun's Subcards. Only the always-available Load half is covered; the [Class Bonus][Level 2+] On Attack "unpreventable" trigger requires a real attack and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Renewable [REST]: Load CARDNAME into target unloaded Gun weapon you control.
